description: Maian vehicle V2 (week PD 2026-11-15/16): the Maian hover vehicle mod, made by the in-game mod author from dev-mods/maian_hover_vehicle/recipe.json (the original example vehicle plus the final model: build_vehicle_mesh.py from the cleaned-up Tripo model, vertex-coloured, with the turret's yaw and pitch parts, 18 ring seats and the crystal toggles; nothing in it comes from the base game), is placed in place of the stage's hoverbike (--debug-swap-vehicle) and driven (--debug-mount-bike). Proves the mod vehicle's own typed model loads in its private model slot (PDVEHICLE.MODEL, no FIX-B.2 model failure), is created at the hoverbike's world scale (VEHICLE.SWAP scale line) and drives on the mod's physics (no VEHICLE.SOURCE loud fail while accelerating and steering). The screenshots show the final model; boost, heat, the gunner seat and the turret come in later steps. Runs on Escape (--launch-mission base:escape). The mount hook places Player 0 beside the bike with chrMoveToPos, which now skips the body model a solo player does not have outside a cutscene (B-1158; the hook used to wait for that model, which never came, so it never mounted on any campaign stage). Escape starts with the player pushing the hover bed (grab mode, as in the original; B-1159, not a bug): after the intro is skipped, one direct-activate press (ACTION_VEHICLE_USE, E) lets go of it, and the mount hook, which waits for walk mode, fires. The mount hook mounts in the same frame walk mode comes back, so the smoke waits only for vehicle_driver_ready after that press (an on-foot wait there never comes true: 2026-11-16 08:48 UTC runs). Since 2026-11-17 it also proves the vehicle's collision mesh holds every triangle of the model (MESHCOL: extracted 5829; B-1236: the extraction used to stop at 4,096 commands of one display list, two commands per triangle, and left the 2,681-triangle hull 637 triangles short).

input_sequence.comment: Escape is live and its intro is playing.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_SKIP_CUTSCENE
input_sequence.comment: Skip the intro. The stage then has the player grab the hover bed.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_USE
input_sequence.comment: Let go of the hover bed: a direct activate in grab mode drops it and gives walk mode back. Only once: a second press could grab it again. The armed mount hook mounts in that same frame.
Player 0 is mounted on the Maian vehicle and driving through LAYER_VEHICLE_DRIVER.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_ACCELERATE
input_sequence.comment: Accelerate: the movement path looks the vehicle's physics up by its model number.

required_lines: VEHICLE\.SWAP: modelnum \d+ takes the world scale of modelnum 58 \(409/4096\)
MESHCOL: extracted 5829 local-space triangles from model
VEHICLE\.GRAPH: modelnum=\d+ graph instance made: nodes=26 exec_edges=21 pending=\d+ parts=1 boost_heat=1
VEHICLE\.SEAT: mount asks for the driver seat \(--debug-mount-seat\)
VEHICLE\.SEAT: modelnum=\d+ driver eye from model part 160 at \(0, 420, 450\) model units
forbidden_patterns: VEHICLE\.GRAPH: modelnum=\d+ has no graph instance
VEHICLE\.GRAPH: modelnum=\d+ tick: a module refused
